artikel.titel: FX Daily: Full EMFX unwind underway
artikel.text: The investment environment remains hostile. Lingering uncertainty over the US tech story, Fed tightening and now a little more tariff uncertainty are leading to a full unwind of risk-seeking trades, particularly in EMFX. More pressure could come today with hot core US PCE inflation. Expect EMFX and commodity FX to remain on the back foot

artikel.titel: German economic rebound lost steam in the third quarter
artikel.text: EUROPE: After the optimism around Germany’s economic resilience in the first half of the year, this morning’s data suggest the recovery is losing steam again

artikel.titel: Rates Spark: Treasuries with blinkers on
artikel.text: We had a solid (post-midterms) consumer sentiment report on Tuesday – ignored by Treasuries. We had the Nvidia reversal on Monday – ignored by Treasuries. Wednesday sees a PCE inflation report that won't be pretty – should be tough for Treasuries to ignore. Or, maybe Treasures are just in a good Thanksgiving mood. Still looks a tad too rosy

artikel.titel: US confidence bounces on fuel price drop and election clarity
artikel.text: NORTH AMERICA: Consumer confidence picked up in November as motor fuel prices fell and sweeping victories in the midterms boosted sentiment amongst Democrats and Independents. Nonetheless, we didn’t see the same reaction in the Michigan measure of sentiment, and the bounce merely closes the gap in the historical relationship between sentiment and spending

artikel.titel: France’s golden rule won’t fix its budget problem
artikel.text: EUROPE: French President Emmanuel Macron’s proposal to revive a constitutional fiscal rule has helped ease pressure on French government bonds. But the reform would only create a framework whose strength would depend on legislation adopted later. The immediate test of France’s fiscal credibility remains the 2027 budget

artikel.titel: Belgium’s government faces year-end deadline for budget deal
artikel.text: BELGIUM: Belgium’s public finances are set to deteriorate further without additional measures. The federal coalition now has until 31 December to reach a budget deal. An agreement on a €10 billion savings package remains our base case, despite the difficult compromises ahead

artikel.titel: Polish consumer resilient despite slower growth in real wages
artikel.text: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: Polish retail sales were resilient in October, helped by strong demand for durable goods. But slower real wage growth and a higher propensity to save have weighed on consumption in recent months. Softer demand is making it harder for firms to pass higher energy costs on to consumers, which prevents broad-based price growth in response to the energy shock

artikel.titel: Unbreakable, German business confidence continues to improve
artikel.text: EUROPE: Germany's most prominent leading indicator, the Ifo index, improved once again, suggesting that the cyclical rebound on the back of fiscal stimulus is set to continue

artikel.titel: The Commodities Feed: Oil extends losses while copper gives back Nvidia bounce
artikel.text: Commodity markets came under renewed pressure on Tuesday. Copper reversed Monday’s Nvidia-driven rebound despite continued physical tightness, while oil extended its decline on hopes of US-Iran talks, and US natural gas fell sharply on milder weather forecasts

artikel.titel: FX Daily: Dollar may be heading into overshoot territory
artikel.text: It is hard to know what to make of Monday's surprise dollar strength. Blaming fresh unhedged inflows into the US tech sector following White House intervention on Nvidia is not that appealing as a rationale. But it may be the case. We think the dollar is starting to head into overshoot territory and would be careful about expecting more strength just yet

trendfolge.regel: Absolute Momentum, 3 Monate (63 Handelstage), täglich entschieden (Antonacci 2014: 12 Monate, monatlich)
trendfolge.hinweis: Täglich entschieden und 3 statt 12 Monate Rückschau sind eigene Wahl, das Paper entscheidet monatlich über 12 Monate. Beides bringt mehr Fehlsignale, wenn der Markt schnell dreht. Keine Anlageberatung.
